summary: Teams design a complete branding package for a school farmers market event, including a required event poster and at least three additional marketing items. The project is submitted as a PDF bundle and presented live to judges, demonstrating design skills, creativity, and teamwork.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than ten (10) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: All graphics must be computer generated. Only team-prepared graphics may be used in the design
Originality and effectiveness will be given greater consideration
It is recommended to be designed at least 300 dpi
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
Team ID is required for all submissions. Materials from non-registered contestants and/or those missing Team ID cannot be accepted
The team is responsible for securing a signed BPA Release Form(s) from any person, including themselves, whose image or work is used in the project
The team is responsible for citing all sources, including themselves, on the Works Cited page for any work used on the project
It is the policy of Business Professionals of America to comply with copyright law. The Style & Reference Manual contains guidelines for Copyright and/or Fair Use
Contestant will be disqualified for violations of the guidelines

This is a pre-submitted event. Regional and state conferences have specific deadlines prior to the national deadlines. Please consult the regional or state conference administrator for those deadlines
For the National Leadership Conference, submit the URL to https://upload.bpa.org no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on April 1, 2027
presubmit_items: Three (3) of the following: Event Logo, Vendor Table Sign, Reusable Shopping Bag Graphic, Social Media Announcement Graphic, Event Program/Map
what_to_bring: Students may use one single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation. Projection equipment and external displays will not be provided or permitted
competencies: Apply graphic design principles & elements, layouts, and typography to align with brand guidelines for digital and print media
Use color theory, visual hierarchy, and illustration techniques to create cohesive, theme-based designs
Create marketing assets to manipulate images and graphics using industry-standard tools for optimization
Develop and present design concepts tailored to target audiences using digital mockups and interactive prototypes
Collaborate effectively as a team in design environments using project management and communication tools

rubric.criterion: Team followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

The following items have been saved as PDFs and bundled together in one PDF file: 1. Event Poster (Required) 2. Works Cited 3. BPA Release Form(s) 4. AI Usage and Documentation Form Three (3) of the following: 5. Event Logo 6. Vendor Table Sign 7. Reusable Shopping Bag Graphic 8. Social Media Announcement Graphic 9. Event Program/Map

rubric.description: Design strongly reflects student needs and interests; highly appropriate.
Designs show exceptional imagination and unique ideas.
Design is highly engaging and attention-grabbing.
All designs complement each other while maintaining distinctiveness.
All designs are well-balanced and harmonious; strong sense of unity.
Colors and fonts are aesthetically pleasing and enhance the design.
Excellent use of negative and positive space; enhances clarity and focus.
Design elements are placed with purpose; strong use of rule of thirds and emphasis.

rubric.criterion: Team followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and the Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

rubric.description: Team maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
Presentation content flows adequately, and each team contestant’s role is clear and integrated into the presentation. Transitions between speakers and/or points are smooth.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges’ questions.

rubric.criterion:
Timing
Setup lasted no longer than three (3) minutes and presentation lasted no more than ten (10) minutes.

Team Members
At least two original team members were present during the presentation.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the team and must take place within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, teams may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: A team will consist of 2-4 contestants
Teams must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines or Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
